correctness.rationale: The twelve arc graph is precisely L(sd(K4)): same first label gives incident half-edges at original vertex, reversal gives pair meeting at a subdivision midpoint. Independently enumerated 162 nonempty independence faces with f-vector (12,48,72,30), reproduced the given pivot sequence producing 78 matched pairs, a single critical 0-cell and five critical 2-cells, and topologically sorted all 432 directed nonempty Hasse covers with 162 visits, proving acyclicity (not merely mod-two rank). Forman then yields integral wedge^5 S^2. Independent enumeration of 24 S4 permutations verified augmented signed Lefschetz character 1+sgn(g)*number of fixed labels, yielding the rational representation. Each group element preserves a nonempty independent arc face, hence fixes its barycenter; Armstrong orbit-space theorem gives simply-connected quotients and rational finite-transfer invariants give the stated averaging formula; S4 and A4 ranks 1 and 2. All finite computations are exhaustive for this stated finite object, not a theorem for all subdivisions.
